name: Sword & Buckler
description:
You are trained in light shields.

Describe your technique.

improvements.name: Buckler Punch
improvements.description: When you roll an engagement success while wielding a light shield, you may spend 1 MP to access the Knockback success.

improvements.name: Untouchable
improvements.description: When wielding a light shield, you gain +WITS Defense instead of the shield's normal Defense bonus.
